strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship WBD with exactly one long-lived public TCP-shaped 4-tuple and one SYN/sequence lineage per VPN session. FakeTCP owns the public flow from SYN; a bounded setup-only reliable phase carries Firefox-120-like real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission; without FIN/RST/close/new SYN the same association switches in-band to pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> LINK/FEC/VPN datagrams. Sustained payload must never inherit ordinary kernel-TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: Feature source head ed7b717d74ffa6fc823685e37a58432d46630ca6 is now the exact same-source Windows/Linux automated physical-test candidate. Windows-native Npcap ingress/persona/runtime tests, Linux raw/netns single-flow E2E, no-HOL, LINK off+20:20, two-client, 20-round dirty reconnect stress, weak-link first-arrival, pcap-loss, RTT20/RTT100 mux load, Windows portable packaging and Linux ARM64/amd64 release all completed successfully. No TCP-like recovery/FEC algorithm change was required in this qualification pass.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not return to the retired dual-public-flow Reality TCP -> close -> FakeTCP design. Keep mature FakeTCP recovery/FEC/sequence/ACK/SACK behavior frozen unless deterministic new evidence requires it. Reproduce any new physical failure in sandbox before changing transport core.

architecture_override.required_public_flow: Exactly one TCP-shaped 4-tuple for the whole WBD session and exactly one SYN lineage. FakeTCP owns public sequence space from SYN through teardown.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered FakeTCP setup stream carries real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission during the first seconds. Client persona is pinned to uTLS Firefox 120; WBD classification is confined to normal TLS-compatible setup bytes.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup switches in-band on the same FakeTCP association to DTLS/datagram mode; no FIN, RST, reconnect or new SYN at the boundary.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered behavior is setup-only. Post-switch payload delivery/recovery must not impose ordinary TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
architecture_override.server_port_model: The raw FakeTCP mux owns WBD sessions from the SYN. Product startup must not launch a separate public kernel-TCP Reality listener for the WBD session. Wrong-marker/non-WBD TLS-like traffic uses the mux fallback/decoy path.

active_single_flow_branch.transport_core_policy: Freeze existing FakeTCP recovery/ACK/SACK/FEC core. This qualification pass added Windows ingress regression coverage and documentation only after the already implemented single-flow architecture.

validated_findings.physical_failure_fix: The prior physical Windows single-flow startup failure `faketcp: not ipv4/tcp` came from unrelated physical Npcap ingress reaching the strict handshake parser. Current Windows backend filters Ethernet/VLAN -> exact unfragmented inbound IPv4/TCP WBD four-tuple before generic parsing, and Windows-native tests now exercise realistic ordered adapter noise.
validated_findings.single_flow: The product no longer uses ordinary Reality TCP -> close -> new FakeTCP SYN. FakeTCP owns the public flow from SYN, carries Reality-like real TLS setup in a temporary reliable stream, then switches in-band to DTLS/LINK/FEC on the same sequence lineage.
validated_findings.no_hol: Dedicated single-flow-no-hol plus Windows virtual-wire tests prove later independent post-switch datagrams can complete while an earlier FakeTCP sequence range is missing.
validated_findings.reconnect: 20 rapid full sessions through persistent NAT/server survive deliberate dirty client termination.
validated_findings.tcp_like_core: No deterministic evidence from this qualification pass requires changes to the mature FakeTCP recovery/ACK/SACK/FEC core; keep it frozen.
validated_findings.remaining_uncertainty: GitHub hosted Windows cannot faithfully emulate the user's installed Npcap driver, physical NIC and real ISP/NAT. That final physical environment is the only remaining acceptance layer.
